name: 도르반
quote: 바람의 궤적을 따라, 멈추지 않는 화살을.
hair: 바람에 흩날리는 연한 하늘색 짧은 머리
silhouette: 옆으로 뻗은 짧은 활, 뒤로 휘날리는 깃털 같은 머리카락, 작은 반투명 날개
signature_motion: 옆으로 미끄러지듯 움직이며 활시위를 당기는 동작
signature_vfx: 에메랄드빛으로 빛나는 부채꼴 모양의 화살 궤적
visual_en: A 2-head tall sprite facing right. The character has short, wind-blown light cyan hair with an emerald gemstone headband. Small, pointed ears and glowing emerald dot eyes stand out. They wear a dark teal short tunic and a leather belt with a small quiver. On their back, small translucent emerald wings flutter. They hold a short bow glowing with emerald light energy. The character's skin is a pale cream color, and they wear simple brown leather sandals. The entire silhouette is accented by sharp emerald light particles to ensure visibility against dark backgrounds.
pose_en: Gliding sideways while pulling a glowing bowstring.
vfx_en: A fan-shaped burst of glowing emerald light streaks.
weapon_en: Short bow with emerald energy flow.
lore: 원거리 사수. 거리를 두고 옆으로 돌며 한 발, 세 발 부채꼴, 느린 유도탄 중 하나를 쏜다.
